# Example models: credits and licences

## Wołpa Synagogue

| | |
|---|---|
| Title | Volpa Synagogue (1929-1941) reconstructed by Katarzyna Prokopiuk |
| Author | Katarzyna Prokopiuk |
| Author affiliation | Warsaw University of Technology |
| Licence | [CC BY-NC-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/) |

Files made from it are under the same licence. Non-commercial use only, with
the author named:

- `WolpaSynagogue.glb`: the model
- `WolpaSynagogue-progressive.glb` and `.preview.glb`: the same model,
  compressed (Meshopt, KTX2)
- `4D/WolpaSynagogue_4D.glb`: the model with exterior ageing stages added
  (generated textures, a weathering model; the interior is unchanged)
- `gallery/WolpaSynagogue-progressive.glb/`: renders of the model
- `tiles/wolpa-points/`: a point cloud sampled from the model
- the intro's points and time-travel textures (`viewer/intro/synagogue-points.bin`,
  `viewer/intro/time/`)
- the manifests `viewer/manifesto/examples/wolpa-synagogue-*.json`, which
  give the licence as `rights` and the credit as `requiredStatement`

Credit line, for example:

> Volpa Synagogue (1929-1941) reconstructed by Katarzyna Prokopiuk (Warsaw
> University of Technology), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
